rules.text:
Twinned Spell
Cost: 1 Sorcery Point
When you cast a spell, such as
Charm Person
, that
can be cast with a higher-level spell slot to target an
additional creature, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point
to increase the spell’s effective level by 1.

authored_operations.trigger: Cast spell that higher-level slot can grant an additional creature target
effects: Effective spell level+1 for cast; apply eligible additional-target progression, not duplicated arbitrary single-target spell
authored_operations.ending_and_identity: Capture edits on exact cast; preserve dice/targets/recipients through settlement; pay once after legal selection.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Map exact option onto every eligible in-band spell payload/host; existing native support is bounded, not universal. Do not mutate global spell definitions.
